# One Mac or PC. Up to 5 Virtual Monitors in XR.

Connect your Mac or PC and build a personal XR setup with multiple screens without adding more physical monitors.

✅ Supports macOS and Windows

💻 Up to 5 virtual monitors

💳 Pay once. No subscription.

—

# 💻 Build Your Multi-Screen Setup

Arrange up to five screens around you and return to the same layout in your next session.

[media]

—

# ✨ More Than Just Screens

Keep useful tools nearby without leaving your XR space.

• Web Browser

• Notes and Pomodoro Timer

• XR Pen for drawing in your space

[media]

—

# 🚀 Get Started in Minutes

1. Download the Host app for macOS or Windows at desk.overay.com

2. Pair your headset and computer

3. Start with a ready-to-use layout or build your own

For a standard wireless connection, keep your computer and headset on the same network.

—

# 💬 Need Help?

Running into an issue? Join our Discord and our team will help you get connected.

→ https://discord.com/invite/hgKnEHfwkr
